verdict.rationale: Stripe is a hosted payments platform, and whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair openness question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never shows Stripe's own product source published under an open license. The only open material is peripheral: GitHub repos for AI SDKs and agent tooling, an OpenAPI spec repo, and an 'open-source client' for Link CLI. These are client libraries and developer building blocks, not the product's source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
